_comment: Sheets and lookups not yet in Temple_Directory_Input_Schema.xlsx. gen-schema.mts merges these after the workbook's own 10_Column_Dictionary and 11_Lookups, so the registry can grow without hand-editing the .xlsx (exceljs cannot round-trip its comments and tables). Every column here is Optional so a temple with no temple-specific mantras is not scored incomplete; row-level rules live in validate.ts. Columns: sheet, column, data_type, requirement, repeatable, description, source_required, public_section.
dictionary: MAN001, MAN002… unique within the temple
Name of the hymn or mantra, e.g. Sri Venkatesa Suprabhatam (verse 1)
Stotram / Suprabhatam / Jyotirlinga / Thevaram / Divya Prabandham / Pilgrim chant / Other
Exact text in its original script, copied from the cited source. Never shown until a temple priest verifies it.
Plain-language meaning written by the team, not copied from a modern translation
Scripture or work it comes from, e.g. Narayaneeyam 1.1
Moment in worship when it is chanted
SOP step this is chanted at
public, or name_only when chanting needs initiation (text is then never shown)
Recording of correct pronunciation (temple-made or licensed)
sourced / authority-verified — public only when authority-verified
